source.caption: End-to-End CryptoVision Workflow. Overview of the workflow including image acquisition from laboratory and web sources, QA/QC filtering, and model training with four fusion strategies—standard (STD), feature concatenation (CONCAT), attention (ATT), and gated (GATED). Models are evaluated using precision, recall, accuracy, and our custom Taxonomic Alignment Score (TAS), and interpreted via saliency maps.
